trigger: Accepting a tenant-protected ledger after its existing suite passes
observation: The four existing tests pass, while new business-boundary probes expose cross-tenant writes, fractional balances and replay failures.
wrong_decision: Treating the pre-existing happy-path suite as a complete acceptance contract
correction: Map each authoritative business promise to role/state/boundary observations before claiming acceptance; product fixes are pending.
scope: This synthetic tenant ledger acceptance exercise; do not infer prevalence in real projects
counterexample: A narrow local change whose existing tests already cover its complete stated contract may need no new suite
